summary: Backend-only verification of public legal HTML pages (Privacy + Terms) and Play Console submission documents. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_legal_and_docs.py with 53 parametrized tests covering all 6 legal routes (status 200 + text/html + >3KB body), full content substring checks for Privacy Policy (title, company, last-updated, all 11 sections, GDPR/CCPA/DPDP, contact) and Terms (title with escaped & tolerance, 13 headings, contact), regression checks for /api/ and /api/auth/guest, plus existence/size/content checks for PLAY-CONSOLE-SUBMISSION.md and QUICK-REFERENCE-CARD.md. All 53 tests PASSED (100%). Additionally sanity-verified that the public ingress URL https://daily-utility-ai.preview.emergentagent.com/api/legal/{privacy,terms} also serves HTTP 200 text/html so the Play Store URL will work.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py exposes legal pages via HTMLResponse and reads static files fresh per request (no in-memory cache). This is fine for the low request volume expected, but if traffic grows the two files could be loaded once at module import.
The routes use include_in_schema=False which correctly hides them from OpenAPI. Good.
No CSP / X-Content-Type-Options headers on the HTML responses. Not required for Play Store submission, but a hardening opportunity.
seed_data_creation: None. Guest auth test creates an ephemeral guest session but no persistent seed data was added.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Legal pages are served from /app/backend/static/{privacy,terms}.html via server.py routes (both root /privacy, /privacy.html and API /api/legal/privacy — same for terms). Play Console submission docs live under /app/branding/. The public preview URL https://daily-utility-ai.preview.emergentagent.com/api/legal/privacy is confirmed reachable and returns 200 text/html — this is the URL to paste into the Play Console 'Privacy Policy URL' field. Test file test_legal_and_docs.py can be reused as regression whenever legal content or routes change.
